compare_body_silhouette_to_image.description: Compare selected native body mesh silhouettes with a calibrated image transform. compare_reference.name: compare_reference
compare_reference.description: Compare the model silhouette with a reference image in one call, seconds. The silhouette is drafted without SolidWorks from code (before any native build) or from the saved part at document_path; source="native" with document_path uses the bodies as built (cuts, patches and anchored features included) and is the check before delivery. Returns IoU, size deltas and a level-by-level table of left/right extents in mm with the worst deviations first, plus an overlay image. Use it to fix proportions before create and as the numeric likeness check before delivery; one call per approved orthographic view.

tolerance_mm.description: A level passes when the model matches within this distance, at a height within the same distance of the level

execute_model_code.name: execute_model_code
execute_model_code.description: Build or edit native solids from Python using the injected model. Analyze is COM-free and returns the predicted extents of every resulting body in milliseconds (draft_views adds silhouette images): check proportions there before a native build that takes minutes; with document_path it previews the edit plan (would_rebuild/would_add/would_remove) without mutation. Create saves a new part. Edit needs document_path and a fresh expected_revision plus one of: patch (small exact replacements in the embedded program, preferred), code (a complete revised program), or only parameters; a failed edit restores the saved part. Revert undoes the last edit. Create and edit frame the working geometry and return views by default. Read warnings in every answer: TUBE_BEND_TOO_TIGHT and SURFACE_PATCH_WIDE_MASK predict a native failure, NATIVE_BODY_INVALID means export_model will refuse the body. Analyze includes component_count, max_components and remaining_components; read model_api_lookup(topic="limits") for the active budgets.

restart_solidworks.name: restart_solidworks
restart_solidworks.description: Verified SolidWorks restart. Use it to release memory after a SOLIDWORKS_MEMORY_HIGH warning (get_executor_status: memory), and for a quarantined session whose MCP owner process exited (owner_alive=false); then follow with reconcile_session(operation_id). Lists open documents and refuses when any is unsaved unless discard_unsaved=true; then exits SolidWorks, waits for the process to end, starts it and reconnects. Documents are not reopened: shape tools open document_path themselves. Returns previous and new PIDs. Takes minutes: collect with wait_operation.
